summary: Composes up to three optional transform inputs (a6, a7, a8) into a packed 4x4 matrix in v16, selected by a null-state switch, then normalizes the result via sub_525E9A. With a blend weight pointer a5 non-null it interpolates vector a4 toward the weight using MMX reciprocal/scale intrinsics and writes the blended vector to a3; otherwise it transforms a4 directly into a3. The composed matrix is applied to a3 in both paths via F_4DVectorTransform. Returns a3.

local_names.a3: output vector receiving the transformed/interpolated result
local_names.a5: blend weight/vector; null selects the direct transform path
local_names.v16: stack-backed composed transform matrix (4x4 packed floats)
local_names.v8: MMX working register in the blend path
local_names.v11: MMX interpolated delta for the first components
local_names.v12: MMX per-component difference for the trailing component
local_names.v13: MMX reciprocal of the trailing difference

operations.description: Switch on the null-state bitmask (a6 != 0) | (2 * ((a7 != 0) | (2 * (a8 != 0)))) using the jump table at jpt_526969 to choose which optional inputs compose the transform.
Case 0 (all inputs null): write an identity matrix to v16 - ones on the diagonal (v16[0], v20, v25, v30), zeros elsewhere.
Case 1: normalize a6 into v16 via sub_525E9A(&v16, 0, a6).
Case 2: normalize a7 into v16 via sub_525E9A(&v16, 0, a7).
Case 3: compose a7 with a6 via F_8SIMDMatrixPackedFloatOperation(a1, a2, &v16, a7, a6), then normalize v16 in place with sub_525E9A.
Case 4: normalize a8 into v16 via sub_525E9A(&v16, 0, a8).
Case 5: compose a8 with a6 via F_8SIMDMatrixPackedFloatOperation, then normalize v16 in place with sub_525E9A.
Case 6: compose a8 with a7 via F_8SIMDMatrixPackedFloatOperation, then normalize v16 in place with sub_525E9A.
Case 7 (all inputs present): compose a8 with a7, compose the result with a6, then normalize v16 in place with sub_525E9A.
Branch on a5 being non-null to select the interpolation path over the direct transform path.

Blend path: convert the weight components with _m_pi2fd, build reciprocal approximations, and compute the interpolated vector as the difference between a4 and the weight scaled against the MMX constant literals (0x4000000040000000, 0x3F8000003F800000, 0x8000000000000000), which the skeleton labels as the SIMD constants qword_5AF980, qword_5AF988 and qword_5AF998.
Blend path: apply the composed matrix to the interpolated vector via F_4DVectorTransform(a3, a3, &v16).
Direct path (a5 null): transform the input vector a4 into a3 via F_4DVectorTransform(a3, a4, &v16).
Return the output vector pointer a3.
